key_insight: Genetically aligned patient representations enhance the accuracy of hematological diagnoses.
clinical_relevance: Incorporating genomic and transcriptomic data significantly improves the performance of diagnostic tasks in blood cancer.
method: Self-supervised, vision-only pretraining on a cohort of over 1500 patients.
Genetic alignment via supervised contrastive loss focusing on acute myeloid leukemia.
evidence_signal: The genetically aligned patient encoder surpasses existing diagnostic models, demonstrating improved retrieval capabilities for diseases and genetic alterations.
watch_item: Implementation may require adaptation to various clinical workflows.
paper_title: Genetically Aligned Patient Representations Improve Hematological Diagnosis
